title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-10
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-03-10
Owner: Liam Chen
Quick context: follow-up from yesterday's canary where long-context prompts occasionally hit a 2-3s tail latency spike (p50 OK, p99 spike). Working on triage + short-term perf wins.

Bugs / Triage
- BUG-ENGINF-2345: tail latency spike under heavy concurrent streaming with kv-cache warm. Repro steps added to ticket.
  - Observed when seq_len > 4k and batch size > 8 on A100-80GB. p99 jumps from ~220ms to 2.3s for last tokens.
  - Hypothesis: KV cache eviction/compaction path holding a global lock during fusion kernel compile.
  - Next: add microbench that simulates many small requests with long seq and streaming enabled. (Ethan to run w/ perf harness)
- BUG: token drop in streaming when tool-calling structured output is enabled + prefix caching. Rare (~0.1%). Likely off-by-one in chunked flush. TODO: add assert to streaming buffer flush. (Maya)

Perf TODOs (short-term)
- Add non-blocking KV compact path: allow background compaction when mem pressure low. Quick patch: use std::shared_mutex rather than exclusive for read-mostly path. (PR draft in repo)
- Improve kernel selection heuristics for sequence lengths 1024-4096. Current rule picks fused-attention-smaller-k that regresses on A100 under tf32 mixed workloads. Try heuristic: prefer kernel X when (seq_len / head_dim) > 16.
- Experiment: increase batch_bucket timeout from 5ms -> 8ms for streaming low-latency buckets; measure p50/p99 tradeoffs. Add metric tags for bucket adjustments.
- Autoscaler tweak: when Dedicated pool is near saturation, route small seq requests to q4_0 quantized variant. Need routing policy change + fallback tests.

Kernel notes / experiments
- fusion_v2 kernel: noticed divergent perf when SM occupancy low. Likely register pressure -> warp divergence on shfl-based rotary. Try compile with -maxrregcount=64 for test build.
- aten-ffi wrapper: add a fast-path for contiguous KV tensors to avoid expensive meta checks on hot loop. Microbench shows 8-12% token throughput improvement on 2k seq.

Commands / quick runs
- repro harness (local): ./tools/perf_sim --model rwl-13b --seq 4096 --batch 12 --streaming --kv-warm
- collect perf counters: nsys profile -o out.nsys ./bin/runtime --trace-hotpath
- kernel compile flags test: bazel build //runtime/kernels:fused_attention --copt=-maxrregcount=64

Measurements from today's quick runs
- baseline (master): p50=210ms p95=420ms p99=2.3s (seq=4096, batch=12, A100-80)
- patch: aten-ffi contiguous fast-path applied -> p50=195ms p95=380ms p99=1.9s (nice)
- compile flag test (-maxrregcount=64) -> p50=200ms p95=360ms p99=1.6s (promising, need more runs)

Open questions / follow-ups
- Is there a better gating metric than batch size for routing to quantized variants? maybe request_length * compute_cost_estimate?
- Should we add 'streaming hint' header for clients that expect strict token-by-token delivery to bypass certain batching heuristics? risk = throughput drop.
- Long-term: rewrite KV compact/evict to lock-free ring buffer. Feasibility + RTT? sketch in confluence page.

Today's action items
- Liam: push aten-ffi fast-path PR + add unit tests for contiguous/non-contig cases. Link in ticket. (due EOD)
- Ethan: run perf harness across cloud pool for nightly run and attach flamegraph. Focus on p99. (due tomorrow)
- Maya: add assert and a small fuzz test for streaming buffer flush to reproduce token-drop case. (due EOD)
- All: sync @ 11:30 standup - quick status + decide whether to roll compile-flag build to canary.

Notes to self
- Keep test vectors / prompts that reproduce kv-warm case in tools/test_vectors/kv_warm_4k.txt
- Remind infra: snapshot of Dedicated pool mem usage around incident times (request IDs in ticket).
- Draft email for customer-facing note if we need to explain brief latency regressions to affected tenants.

Random scraps
- Thought: could we expose a "max_stream_latency_ms" hint per request so runtime can dynamically lower batch window? might help tail latency for critical streams.
- Flag idea: runtime config "kv_compact_background=true" default off for now.

-- end --
